title: The Danger of a Single Story
reference_summary: The talk explores how cultures and lives contain overlapping stories and warns that relying on a single story about a person or country can lead to serious misunderstanding.

title: Your Body Language May Shape Who You Are
reference_summary: The talk explains how body language affects how others perceive us and discusses the idea that adopting confident postures may influence our own feelings of confidence and potential success.

title: The History of Our World in 18 Minutes
reference_summary: The talk presents a wide-angle history of the universe from the Big Bang to the Internet, examining the development of complexity, life and humanity.

title: The power of vulnerability
reference_source: Brené Brown discusses her research into vulnerability, courage, authenticity, and shame, and explores how embracing vulnerability can help people develop meaningful connections and live more wholeheartedly.
